m_questTitle: How I Learned to Stop Worrying

m_tallyCounter.m_descriptor: Dorian to gate to Moon Cliffs

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Though we are right beneath their mandibles!
It is a good thing you have that Comb Key, however it only allows a few people to pass through the Honeycomb Gate at a time.
The Gate lies in the center of the Honeycomb Wall - an accursed construction of Randozz the Builder.
It was built after the fall of Bastion. The Honeycomb Wall contains us and prevents Elizar from mounting a full attack on the Apiary!
We'll have to be careful sneaking through the Apiary.
We need to go down through Bumbler Town and to the Moon Cliff Gates to get into Bastion.
Very good, Spellbinder. Let's hurry across Bastion and the Silent Market and through the Tyrian Gate.
Tyrian Gorge is dangerous, as you well know. We need to find a good vantage point.
Elizar has ordered me to Tyrian Gorge, to turn the Umbra Legions weapons against them.
I'll need your help getting there. We will have to go through the Last Wood, the Moon Cliffs, and Bastion to get there.
I will follow you closely, Spellbinder!
Please escort me to Tyrian Gorge. We must leave at once!
